outcomes.text: with support, recognise and communicate meaning in Chinese
explore, with support, language features of Chinese noticing similarities and differences between Chinese and English
explore connections between language and culture
interact in classroom-related routines; and personal introductions
collaborate with others in a range of play-based activities using modelled expressions and visual and spoken cues

topics.title: Mediating meaning in and between languages

subtopics.title: Mediating meaning in and between languages

outcomes.text: locate, with support, key information in spoken and written texts, and respond using gestures, images, words and modelled sentences

with support, create spoken, written and multimodal texts, using familiar words, modelled phrases and sentences, copying known characters and Pinyin
recognise and use sound patterns and tones of Chinese

recognise that Chinese has features that may be similar to or different from English

initiate exchanges and respond to questions about home and classroom environments, using familiar expressions
participate in activities that involve planning and transacting with others, using a range of phrases, structures and modelled sentences in familiar contexts

develop strategies to interpret language that conveys cultural meaning

create and present informative and imaginative spoken, written and multimodal texts, using a range of sentence structures and modelled textual conventions, characters appropriate to context, and/or Pinyin
